questions.question: Who among the following became the first woman to win the Abel Prize 2019?
questions.solution:
• **Karen Uhlenbeck** was the first woman to be awarded the Abel Prize in history
 
• The Abel Prize is an annual prize awarded by the King of Norway to excellent mathematicians
 
• It is named after the famous Norwegian mathematician Niels Henrik Abel 
 
• Karen Uhlenbeck, a professor at University of Texas won the prize for her pioneering achievements in geometric partial differential equations, gauge theory and integrable systems, and for the fundamental impact of her work on analysis, geometry and mathematical physics

questions.question: Silent Valley National Park is located in the Indian state of ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Kerala**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Silent Valley National Park is a beautiful representation of the last remaining rainforest of Kerala.
 
• Silent Valley was declared as National Park in 1984 and formally inaugurated in the year 1985.
 
• In 1914, Silent Valley forests were declared as Reserved Forest. Till 1921, Silent Valley was part of the South Malabar Forest Division with headquarters at Nilambur.
 
• In 1921, it came under the control of the Palakkad Forest Division and managed so until 1988.
 
• 41 mammals, 211 birds, 49 reptiles, 47 amphibians, 12 fishes, 164 butterflies, and 400 species of moths are found here.
 
• This park harbors a viable population of Lion-tailed macaques which also is the flagship species of the Park.
 
• It is at the heart of Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve and consists of areas of South Western Ghats rain forests and tropical wet evergreen jungle.
 
 
• River Kunthi passes through it.
 
 
 
• Flora: Humid wet Evergreen Rain Forests. The major plants of the park are Teak, Amla, Semal, Rosewood along bamboo.
 
• Fauna: Silent Valley Park is known for many highly endangered species such as lion-tailed macaque, tiger, gaur, leopard, wild boar, panther, Indian Civet, and Sambhar.

questions.question: Which of the following is a vestigial organ?
questions.solution:
• **The appendix **is a vestigial organ out of the above options
 
• A vestigial organ is an organ in the body that has lost its use because of evolution
 
• In other words the organ did serve some purpose in the past for the species but now has been reduced to something smaller and simple as it is no longer needed
 
• The actual function of the appendix from the past is still unknown
 
• Some other examples of vestigial organs are the tail bone and wisdom teeth

questions.question: Mahatma Gandhi formed the Natal Indian Congress in the year ______.
questions.solution:
• Mahatma Gandhi founded the Natal Indian Congress **in the year 1894.**
 
• The Natal Indian Congress (NIC) was an organization formed to fight the discrimination faced by Indians in South Africa
 
• Gandhi was the first Honorary Secretary of the Congress.
 
• This organisation went on to lead many non-violent protests in the cause of discrimination faced not just by Indians but also by native Africans.

questions.question: The explosion of crackers is an example of ___________.
questions.solution:
• Crackers explode because of **a combustion reaction **that takes place
 
• The explosion is caused when the chemicals present in the powder filling are ignited
 
• Combustion is a reaction in which a substance burns in the presence of oxygen to release energy
 
• The released energy from the reaction is what causes the display of light and also the heat that is emitted from the crackers
 
• The basic reaction can be summed up as:**Reagent + Oxygen → Product + Energy**

questions.question: What is the name given to the graph that shows all the combinations of two commodities that a consumer can afford at given market prices and within the particular income level in economic terms?
questions.solution:
• **The Budget Line** shows all the combinations of two commodities that a consumer can afford at given market prices and within the particular income level in economic terms
 
• In other words, the budget line will show how much quantity of two commodities can be bought by consumer if a certain budget is fixed
 
• The two constraints in this particular scenario are the fixed budget and the market price of the two goods
 
• If there are two goods X and Y, the budget equation can be expressed by **Pₓ X Qₓ + Py X Qy = M**
 
• Where Pₓ and Py are prices of X and Y, Qx and Qy are quantities of X and Y and M is the money income (budget) of consumer

questions.question: What is the geographic name given to a deep and narrow valley consisting of steep sides created by weathering and erosion by rivers, wind, rain and tectonic activity?
questions.solution:
• **A canyon **is a deep and narrow valley that is formed by weathering, erosion or tectonic activity
 
• Most canyons are formed by long time erosion of a plateau or table land
 
• Rivers have a tendency to carve out canyons in the terrains as moving water can cause large scale erosion over long periods of time
 
• The largest canyon in the world is the Yarlung Tsangpo Grand Canyon situated in Tibet which is at 5,500 meters

questions.question: Of which Indian states is 'Gamocha' a cultural symbol?
questions.solution:
• The Gamocha **is a cultural symbol of Assamese culture**
 
• It is an article of clothing which is also known as Gamusa in Assamese.
 
• It is primarily a white rectangular piece of clothing that is made from Pat Silk traditionally.
 
• It has red borders on three of its side and red woven motif on the fourth one.
 
• Even though traditionally Pat Silk was used to make it, common Gamochas are made of cotton yarn.

questions.question: An economic condition when there is one buyer and many sellers is called ______.
questions.solution:
• **A monopsony **is a market condition where there is a single buyer with many sellers
 
• It is in fact a condition which is opposite to that of a monopoly
 
• In a monopsony the single buyer has large control on the market as the major purchaser of goods and services provided by many sellers
 
• An example would be a food retailer that buys supplies from many farmers growing the same crop
